checks: Both locale dictionaries have matching keys
Redaction covers nested credentials, email, phone, echoed values, URL query and JSON text
Redaction preserves zero, false and JSON null without mutating source snapshots
Restore removes entire affected top-level parameters and never inserts redaction markers
Filters combine status, server, environment, actor, upload state and date range
Invalid date ranges show an error and no results; reset restores the collection
Pagination and sort do not modify source order, and queries reset page index
Tool collections constrain both connection ID and tool name
Project filters and detail state cannot bleed between projects
Empty collection offers debugging while filtered results offer filter reset
Request, response, protocol, and copy preview never reveal known fixture secrets
Custom rules validate JSON pointers and can only increase masking
Retries upload the same ID and redacted payload without creating calls
Recovery only changes platform availability, then retry succeeds and leaves execution success untouched
Upload jobs are isolated for identical record IDs in different projects
Request-only, missing responses and valid null responses remain distinguishable
Request-only snapshot with a deleted source does not imply a cancelled call
Save freezes its source; empty names are rejected and no request is queued
Saved upload failures retain an independent, redacted snapshot and retry does not duplicate it
Editing metadata preserves snapshots and blocks a second edit while upload is pending
Loading saved snapshots uses the redacted restore path without returning old response
Private records from another owner stay hidden, including direct details and copying
Viewer role cannot upload, modify masks, clear history, save or delete records
Metadata editors and filters preserve their values across locale changes
Clearing uploaded unpinned history preserves pinned calls, pending uploads and saved records
Deleting a saved record requires a manageable record and leaves source history untouched
Untrusted record labels and notes are escaped
